When «case» names no intent, judge by the occasion, her day and the outfit's own idea — not by which outfit is the quietest or the cleanest.","The code's remarks are information about each outfit, not a score: weigh what each one means for her; do not count them and do not choose by how few remarks an outfit has or how mild they are. A bolder outfit that serves her better wins over a quieter one with fewer remarks.","A finding with «register» «gate» stops the outfit unless you accept it: if the outfit you choose has gates, accept each of them in «accept» with why it serves her here. That is your weighed decision and not a reason to pass over the outfit.","You may also keep a remark on purpose: in «accept», name its existing «id» from «remarks_by_code», with a non-empty «why». Accept only findings of the chosen outfit; do not invent ids. Remarks need no acceptance unless you mean to declare that deliberate choice; «your_declared» and the overall «why» do not accept findings by themselves.","When «case» has «palette_scheme», she chose that scheme herself: an outfit whose large items carry its families answers her own choice. A section with rows has one knowledge vector per row of that list/table, in the exact same order; a table's cols/rows represent logical item rows. A section with item gives the vector for that single item. null means no knowledge supplied. Vector indices refer to facts in property order. defaults is the explicit complete three-index vector: append its trailing indices to a shorter vector; a scalar is a one-index vector. Only explicitly listed items use defaults. Each fact is [descriptor index, value]; each descriptor is [status, source, applicability index]. applicability records give applicability and its source. Applicability is independent of status; unknown never proves NA. measured: known value from that source; range: only that window/alternatives; unknown: no supported fact; not_applicable: explicit inapplicability. Composition_raw means unparsed shop text, never coded composition. Metal unknown never proves no metal. A value {field, conversion} references that same item's existing field: lab is the exact Lab value; hex uses colorspace.hx (sRGB to CIELab D65); hx_round2 uses the existing feed producer's two-decimal representation after hx.
